name: virtual-drone-expert

displayDescription.zh: 上传任意视频，一键生成模仿 GTA6 或虚拟无人机跟拍风格的电影级空中视角视频。
displayDescription.en: Upload any video to generate cinematic virtual drone follow shots inspired by GTA6-style aerial camera work.

description: A prompt-based expert that turns any uploaded video into a virtual drone-style follow shot. It analyses the subject, scene and motion, designs a virtual aerial camera path, and drives the host platform's video generation model to produce GTA6-style or Tesla Reality View-inspired footage. It ships no model weights or inference code; output is a stylised re-imagining rather than an accurate 3D reconstruction.

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 请上传一段视频，我将为您设计虚拟无人机跟拍方案并生成视频。
defaultInitPrompt.en: Please upload a video, and I will design a virtual drone follow shot and generate it for you.

quickPrompts.zh: 将这段视频转换成 GTA6 风格的空中跟拍镜头。
quickPrompts.en: Convert this video into a GTA6-style aerial follow shot.
